title.zh: 卷36 列傳第28 鄭偉 楊纂 段永 王士良 崔彥穆 令狐整 司馬裔 裴果
title.en: Volume 36 Biographies 28: Zheng Wei; Yang Zuan; Duan Yong; Wang Shiliang; Cui Yanmu; Ling Huzheng; Sima Yi; Pei Guo
title.raw: 卷36 列傳第28 鄭偉 楊纂 段永 王士良 崔彥穆 令狐整 司馬裔 裴果 Volume 36 Biographies 28: Zheng Wei; Yang Zuan; Duan Yong; Wang Shiliang; Cui Yanmu; Ling Huzheng; Sima Yi; Pei Guo

sentences.zh: 鄭偉 楊纂 段永 王士良 崔彥穆 令狐整 司馬裔 裴果 劉志

translations.literal: Zheng Wei, Yang Zuan, Duan Yong, Wang Shiliang, Cui Yanmu, Linghu Zheng, Sima Yi, Pei Guo, Liu Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wei; Yang Zuan; Duan Yong; Wang Shiliang; Cui Yanmu; Linghu Zheng; Sima Yi; Pei Guo; and Liu Zhi.

sentences.zh: 鄭偉字子直，滎陽開封人也，小名闍提，魏將作大匠渾之十一世孫。

translations.literal: Zheng Wei, styled Zizhi, was a man of Kaifeng in Xingyang; his childhood name was Chanti; he was the eleventh-generation descendant of Hunzhi, Wei Director of Palace Construction.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wei, courtesy name Zizhi, came from Kaifeng in Xingyang. His childhood name was Chanti, and he was eleventh in descent from Hunzhi, who had served Wei as director of palace construction.

sentences.zh: 祖思明，少勇悍，仕魏至直閤將軍，贈濟州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Siming from youth was fierce and bold; he served Wei until attaining the rank of direct-palace general and was posthumously given Inspector of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Siming had been fierce from youth; he rose in Wei service to direct-palace general and was posthumously made inspector of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 父先護，亦以武勇聞。

translations.literal: His father Xianhu was also known for martial valor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xianhu likewise won renown for courage in battle.

sentences.zh: 起家員外散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: He began his career as acting attendant of scattered cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Xianhu entered office as acting attendant of scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 魏孝莊帝在藩，先護早自結托。

translations.literal: While Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei was still in the princely residence, Xianhu early attached himself to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhuang was still a prince, Xianhu had already pledged himself to him.

sentences.zh: 及卽位，歷通直散騎常侍、平南將軍、廣州刺史，賜平昌縣侯。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhuang took the throne, he passed through the posts of regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry, general who pacifies the south, and inspector of Guang Province, and was granted Marquis of Pingchang county.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiaozhuang acceded, Xianhu served as regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry, general who pacifies the south, and inspector of Guang Province, and was enfeoffed as marquis of Pingchang.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，以禦扞之功，累遷都督二豫郢雍四州諸軍、征東將軍、豫州刺史，兼尚書右僕射，進爵郡公。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, for achievements in resisting him Xianhu was successively promoted to area commander of the armies of the two Yu, Ying, and Yong provinces, general who campaigns east, inspector of Yu Province, concurrently right vice-director of the Masters of Writing, and advanced to a commandery duke.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao seized Luoyang, Xianhu was rewarded for holding him off with successive promotions to commander of armies in Yu, Ying, and Yong, general who campaigns east, inspector of Yu Province, and right vice-director of the Masters of Writing, and was raised to commandery duke.

sentences.zh: 尋入為車騎將軍、左衛將軍。

translations.literal: Soon after he entered [the capital] as general of chariots and cavalry and left guard general.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon summoned to court as general of chariots and cavalry and left guard general.

sentences.zh: 及爾朱榮死，徐州刺史爾朱仲遠擁兵將入洛，詔先護以本官假驃騎將軍、大都督，率所部與行臺楊昱及都督賀拔勝同討之。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Erzhu Zhongyuan, inspector of Xu Province, massed troops to enter Luoyang; an edict appointed Xianhu in his existing office with provisional title general of fast cavalry and area commander, to lead his troops together with the mobile headquarters of Yang Yu and area commander Helba Sheng to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: After Erzhu Rong's death, Erzhu Zhongyuan of Xu Province gathered an army to march on Luoyang. An edict made Xianhu provisional general of fast cavalry and area commander in his existing rank and ordered him, with Yang Yu's mobile headquarters and Helba Sheng, to crush Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 勝於陣降仲遠，又聞京師不守，衆遂潰。

translations.literal: Sheng surrendered Zhongyuan in battle; on hearing the capital had fallen, the forces dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng surrendered to Zhongyuan on the field; when word came that the capital was lost, the army broke apart.

sentences.zh: 先護奔梁。

translations.literal: Xianhu fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Xianhu escaped into Liang territory.

sentences.zh: 尋自梁歸，為仲遠所害。

translations.literal: Shortly after he returned from Liang, Zhongyuan had him killed.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he came back from Liang, Zhongyuan put him to death.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武初，贈使持節、都督、青齊兗豫四州刺史。

translations.literal: At the opening of Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was posthumously given bearer of the staff with full powers, area commander, and inspector of the four provinces Qing, Qi, Yan, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was posthumously granted bearer of the staff, area commander, and inspector of Qing, Qi, Yan, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 偉少倜儻有大志，每以功名自許，善騎射，膽力過人。

translations.literal: Wei from youth was unrestrained and lofty in aspiration, always measuring himself by achievement and fame; he was skilled in horsemanship and archery, and his courage and strength surpassed other men.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was free-spirited from youth and dreamed of great deeds, always setting his sights on glory; he excelled at riding and archery, and his nerve and strength outmatched ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 爾朱氏滅後，自梁歸魏。

translations.literal: After the Erzhu clan was destroyed, he returned from Liang to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Erzhu house fell, he came back from Liang to Wei.

sentences.zh: 起家通直散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: He began his career as attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 及孝武西遷，偉亦歸鄉里，不求仕進。

translations.literal: When Xiaowu moved west, Wei also returned to his home region and sought no advancement in office.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaowu withdrew westward, Wei went home as well and refused further office.

sentences.zh: 大統三年，河內公獨孤信旣復洛陽，偉乃謂其親族曰：「今嗣主中興鼎業，據有崤、函。

translations.literal: In Datong year 3, after Duke of Henei Dugu Xin had recovered Luoyang, Wei said to his kinsmen: "Now the heir to the throne is restoring the imperial enterprise and holds the passes at Xiao and Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Datong, after Dugu Xin, Duke of Henei, had retaken Luoyang, Wei told his kin, "The heir is reviving the dynasty and now holds the Xiao and Han passes.

sentences.zh: 河內公親董衆軍，克復瀍、洛，率土之內，孰不延首望風。

translations.literal: The Duke of Henei personally directs the hosts of army, has retaken Chan and Luo; within the realm, who does not crane his neck and look to the wind?
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Henei himself commands the armies and has won back the Chan and Luo region. Who under Heaven is not straining to see which way fortune will blow?

sentences.zh: 況吾等世荷朝恩，家傳忠義，誠宜以此時效臣子之節，成富貴之資。

translations.literal: Moreover we for generations have borne the dynasty's grace; our house inherits loyalty and righteousness — truly we ought at this time to fulfill a subject's duty and secure the capital of wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: We have enjoyed imperial favor for generations, and loyalty runs in our blood. This is the moment to prove ourselves as subjects and win the rewards that follow.

sentences.zh: 豈可碌碌為懦夫之事也！

translations.literal: How can we drudge along doing a coward's work!
translations.idiomatic: How can we waste our lives like timid nobodies!"

sentences.zh: 」於是與宗人榮業，糺合州里，建義於陳留。

translations.literal: Thereupon together with his clansman Rongye he gathered the district and raised righteousness at Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined his clansman Rongye in rallying the countryside and raising the banner of loyalty at Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 信宿間，衆有萬餘人。

translations.literal: Within a day or two the host numbered more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In only a day or two their force swelled to more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 遂攻拔梁州，擒東魏刺史鹿永吉及鎮城令狐德，幷獲陳留郡守趙季和。

translations.literal: Then they stormed and took Liang Province, captured Eastern Wei inspector Lu Yongji and the defender of the fortress city Linghu De, and also seized Chenliu commandery administrator Zhao Jihe.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed Liang Province, took Eastern Wei inspector Lu Yongji and fortress commander Linghu De prisoner, and captured Chenliu administrator Zhao Jihe as well.

sentences.zh: 乃率衆來附。

translations.literal: Then he led the host to submit and attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: He then led his men west to submit to the court.

sentences.zh: 因是梁、陳之間，相次降款。

translations.literal: Because of this, between Liang and Chen successive groups surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On his example, districts between Liang and Chen surrendered one after another.

sentences.zh: 偉馳入朝，太祖與語歎美之。

translations.literal: Wei raced to court; the Grand Progenitor spoke with him and sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Wei hurried to court, and Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai spoke with him and praised him warmly.

sentences.zh: 拜龍驤將軍、北徐州刺史，封武陽縣伯，邑六百戶。

translations.literal: He was appointed general of soaring dragon, inspector of Northern Xu Province, enfeoffed Baron of Wuyang county with a fief of six hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was made general of soaring dragon and inspector of Northern Xu Province, enfeoffed as baron of Wuyang with six hundred households.

sentences.zh: 從戰河橋及解玉壁圍，偉常先鋒陷陣。

translations.literal: Following campaigns at Heqiao and in lifting the siege of Yubi, Wei constantly led the vanguard and broke through battle lines.
translations.idiomatic: At Heqiao and in the relief of Yubi he repeatedly led the charge and smashed enemy lines.

sentences.zh: 侯景歸款，太祖命偉率所部應接之。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing submitted, the Grand Progenitor ordered Wei to lead his troops to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing defected, Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai ordered Wei to march out and receive him.

sentences.zh: 及景後叛，偉亦全軍而還。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing afterward rebelled, Wei also returned with his army intact.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing later turned rebel, Wei withdrew with his force unbroken.

sentences.zh: 錄前後功，除中軍將軍、滎陽郡守，加散騎常侍、大都督，進爵襄城郡公，邑二千戶，加車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Recording his earlier and later achievements, he was appointed general of the central army and administrator of Xingyang commandery, additionally given scattered-cavalry regular attendant and area commander, advanced to Duke of Xiangcheng commandery with a fief of two thousand households, and given great general of chariots and cavalry and grand master with golden seal open office with ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: For his accumulated service he was made general of the central army and administrator of Xingyang, given scattered-cavalry regular attendant and area commander, raised to duke of Xiangcheng with two thousand households, and granted great general of chariots and cavalry with an open office equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.

sentences.zh: 魏恭帝二年，進位大將軍，除江陵防主、都督十五州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In Wei Gongdi year 2 he was promoted to great general, appointed defender-commander of Jiangling and area commander of the military affairs of fifteen provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Emperor Gong of Wei he was promoted to great general, made defender of Jiangling, and given command over military affairs in fifteen provinces.

sentences.zh: 偉性麄獷，不遵法度，睚眥之間，便行殺戮。

translations.literal: Wei's nature was coarse and fierce; he did not observe the laws; over the smallest grudge he would carry out killings.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was rough and violent, cared little for law, and would kill over the slightest slight.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以其有立義之效，每優容之。

translations.literal: The court because he had the effect of raising righteousness, each time looked upon him with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had raised the loyal standard, the court repeatedly indulged him.

sentences.zh: 及在江陵，乃專戮副防主杞賓王，坐除名。

translations.literal: When at Jiangling he arbitrarily executed Vice Defender Qi Binwang and was removed from his post by court sentence.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiangling he killed Vice Defender Qi Binwang on his own authority and was stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 保定元年，詔復官爵，仍除宜州刺史。

translations.literal: In Baoding year 1 an edict restored his office and ennoblement, and he was again appointed inspector of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding an edict restored his titles, and he was again made inspector of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 天和六年，轉華州刺史。

translations.literal: In Tianhe year 6 he was transferred to inspector of Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianhe he was transferred to inspector of Hua Province.

sentences.zh: 偉前後莅職，皆以威猛為治，吏民莫敢犯禁，盜賊亦為之休止。

translations.literal: Wei in his successive posts in office all used ferocity and might in administration; officials and people dared not violate prohibitions, and bandits also on account of this ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In every post Wei ruled by fear and force; officials and commoners alike dared not break the law, and even bandits fell quiet.

sentences.zh: 雖無仁政，然頗以此見稱。

translations.literal: Though he had no benevolent governance, yet he was rather praised for this.
translations.idiomatic: He was no benevolent administrator, yet people spoke well of his results.

sentences.zh: 其年卒於州，時年五十七。

translations.literal: That year he died in the province at age fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died that year in office, aged fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈本官，加少傅、都督司豫洛相冀五州諸軍事、司州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously given his existing office, additionally junior mentor, area commander of the military affairs of the five provinces Si, Yu, Luo, Xiang, and Ji, and inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted his last office plus junior mentor, command over military affairs in Si, Yu, Luo, Xiang, and Ji, and the post of inspector of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 諡曰肅。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Su (Stern).
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous name Stern.

sentences.zh: 偉性吃，少時嘗逐鹿於野，失之，遇牧豎而問焉。

translations.literal: Wei had a stutter; in youth he once was chasing a deer in the wilds, lost it, and met a shepherd boy and questioned him.
translations.idiomatic: Wei stuttered. Once in youth, while hunting a deer in the open country, he lost the trail and questioned a shepherd boy he met.

sentences.zh: 牧豎答之，其言亦吃。

translations.literal: The shepherd boy answered him, and his speech also stuttered.
translations.idiomatic: The boy answered — and stuttered as well.

sentences.zh: 偉怒，謂其效己，遂射殺之。

translations.literal: Wei grew angry, thinking the boy was mocking him, and shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: Wei flew into a rage, decided the boy was mimicking him, and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 其忍暴如此。

translations.literal: His cruelty and violence were thus.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the measure of his brutality.

sentences.zh: 子大士嗣。

translations.literal: His son Dashi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Dashi inherited the line.

sentences.zh: 偉族人頂字寧伯，少有幹用。

translations.literal: Wei's clansman Ding, styled Ningbo, from youth had capability and usefulness.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's kinsman Ding, courtesy name Ningbo, showed ability and practical talent from youth.

sentences.zh: 起家員外散騎侍郎，稍遷行臺左丞、陽城陳留二郡守。

translations.literal: He began his career as acting attendant of scattered cavalry, and was gradually transferred to left aide of the mobile headquarters and administrator of the two commanderies Yangcheng and Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office as acting attendant of scattered cavalry and rose to left aide of the mobile headquarters and administrator of Yangcheng and Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 與偉同謀立義。

translations.literal: He together with Wei plotted to raise righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: He had plotted the loyal rising together with Wei.

sentences.zh: 後隨偉入朝，賜爵魏昌縣伯，除太府少卿。

translations.literal: Later following Wei to court he was granted Baron of Weichang county and appointed junior mentor-director of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Wei to court, was enfeoffed as baron of Weichang, and appointed junior director of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 出為扶風郡守，復為太府少卿，轉衛尉少卿。

translations.literal: Sent out as administrator of Fufeng commandery, again made junior mentor-director of the Imperial Treasury, transferred to junior mentor-director of the Guard Commandant's office.
translations.idiomatic: He served as administrator of Fufeng, returned as junior director of the Imperial Treasury, and was then transferred to junior director of the Guard Commandant's office.

sentences.zh: 歷職內外，竝有恪勤之稱。

translations.literal: In posts inside and outside the court he alike had a reputation for conscientious diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Whether at court or in the provinces he won praise for steady, devoted service.

sentences.zh: 尋卒官。

translations.literal: Soon he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office not long after.

sentences.zh: 贈儀同三司、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously given ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers and inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers and the title inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 子常，字子元。

translations.literal: His son Chang, styled Ziyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Chang, courtesy name Ziyuan.

sentences.zh: 頗涉學，有當官譽。

translations.literal: He considerably entered into learning and had a reputation for office competence.
translations.idiomatic: He had read widely and was known as a capable official.

sentences.zh: 歷撫軍將軍、通直散騎常侍、司皮下大夫，遷信東徐南兗三州刺史。

translations.literal: He passed through general who soothes the army, regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry, lower grandee of the Skins Office, and was transferred to inspector of the three provinces Xin, Eastern Xu, and Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as general who soothes the army, regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry, lower grandee of the Skins Office, and then as inspector of Xin, Eastern Xu, and Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 以立義及累戰功，授上開府、儀同大將軍，賜爵饒陽侯。

translations.literal: For raising righteousness and accumulated battle achievements he was given supreme open office and great general with ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and granted Marquis of Raoyang.
translations.idiomatic: For the loyal rising and repeated battle merit he received supreme open office, the rank of great general with ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and the marquisate of Raoyang.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈本官，加郢鄯陝三州諸軍事、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On death posthumously given his existing office, additionally military commander of the three provinces Ying, Shan, and Shaan, and inspector of Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: At his death he was posthumously granted his last office plus command over military affairs in Ying, Shan, and Shaan and the post of inspector of Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 子神符。

translations.literal: Son Shenfu.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Shenfu.

sentences.zh: 楊纂，廣寧人也。

translations.literal: Yang Zuan was a man of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zuan came from Guangning.

sentences.zh: 父安仁，魏北道都督、朔州鎮將。

translations.literal: His father Anren was Wei area commander of the northern route and fortress general of Shuo Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Anren had been Wei area commander of the northern route and fortress general of Shuo Province.

sentences.zh: 纂少習軍旅，慷慨有志略，尤工騎射，勇力兼人。

translations.literal: Zuan from youth practiced military life; he was high-spirited with ambition and strategy; especially skilled in horsemanship and archery; his courage and strength were the equal of two men.
translations.idiomatic: Zuan trained in arms from youth, was bold and far-sighted, excelled at riding and archery, and possessed the strength of two ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 年二十，從齊神武起兵於信都，以軍功稍遷安西將軍、武州刺史。

translations.literal: At age twenty he followed Gao Huan in raising troops at Xindu; through military achievements he was gradually transferred to general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu Province.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty he joined Gao Huan's rising at Xindu and, on merit in battle, rose step by step to general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu Province.

sentences.zh: 自以功高賞薄，志懷怨憤，每歎曰：「大丈夫富貴何必故鄉。

translations.literal: He considered his achievements high and rewards meager; his mind harbored resentment; he often sighed: "For a great man, why must wealth and honor come in one's native place?
translations.idiomatic: Feeling his service had outrun his rewards, he brooded on resentment and often sighed, "Must a true man win wealth and rank only in his home country?

sentences.zh: 若以妻子撓懷，豈不沮人雄志！

translations.literal: If one lets wife and children soften the heart, will this not dampen a man's heroic aspiration!
translations.idiomatic: If wife and children tie down the heart, how can a man's great ambition survive?"

sentences.zh: 」大統初，乃間行歸款。

translations.literal: At the opening of Datong he by hidden routes came to submit and declare loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Datong he slipped through by secret paths to offer his allegiance.

sentences.zh: 太祖執纂手曰：「人所貴者忠義也，所懼者危亡也，其能不憚危亡蹈茲忠義者，今方見之於卿耳。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor took Zuan's hand and said: "What men esteem is loyalty and righteousness; what they fear is peril and destruction; one who can not fear peril and destruction and tread this loyalty and righteousness — now I see such a one in you."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai took his hand and said, "Men prize loyalty and righteousness and dread ruin. One who dares ruin for loyalty — I see that man in you today."

sentences.zh: 」卽授征南將軍、大都督，封永興縣侯，邑八百戶，加通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He was immediately given general who campaigns south and area commander, enfeoffed Marquis of Yongxing county with eight hundred households, additionally regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was at once made general who campaigns south and area commander, enfeoffed as marquis of Yongxing with eight hundred households, and given regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 纂性質樸，又不識文字，前後莅職，但推誠信而已。

translations.literal: Zuan's nature was plain and honest; moreover he did not know written characters; in his successive posts in office he only extended sincerity and trustworthiness.
translations.idiomatic: Zuan was plain and unlettered; in every office he governed simply by sincerity and good faith.

sentences.zh: 吏以其忠恕，頗亦懷之。

translations.literal: Officials because of his loyalty and forbearance also somewhat cherished him in their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates, moved by his loyalty and forbearance, came to hold him in genuine affection.

sentences.zh: 尋卒于州，時年六十七。

translations.literal: Soon he died in the province at age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office not long after, aged sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 子睿嗣。

translations.literal: His son Rui succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Rui inherited the line.

sentences.zh: 位至上柱國、漁陽郡公。

translations.literal: He attained the rank of supreme pillar of state and Duke of Yuyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Rui rose to supreme pillar of state and duke of Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 段永字永賓，其先遼西石城人，晉幽州刺史匹磾之後也。

translations.literal: Duan Yong, styled Yongbin, his forebears were men of Shicheng in Liaoxi; descendants of Pi Di, Jin inspector of You Province.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Yong, courtesy name Yongbin, came from Shicheng in Liaoxi and traced descent to Pi Di, Jin inspector of You Province.

sentences.zh: 曾祖愄，仕魏，黃龍鎮將，因徙高陸之河陽焉。

translations.literal: Great-grandfather Min served Wei as fortress general of Huanglong and on that account moved to Heyang in Gaolu.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Min served Wei as fortress general of Huanglong and resettled the family at Heyang in Gaolu.

sentences.zh: 永幼有志操，閭里稱之。

translations.literal: Yong from youth had aspiration and integrity; the neighborhood praised him.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Yong showed resolve and moral seriousness, and neighbors spoke well of him.

sentences.zh: 魏正光末，六鎮擾亂，遂攜老幼，避地中山。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhengguang in Wei, when the six garrisons were disturbed in disorder, he then took old and young and sought refuge in Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: When the six northern garrisons erupted in chaos at the end of the Zhengguang era, he led the old and young of his household to refuge at Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 後赴洛陽。

translations.literal: Later he went to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He later made his way to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 拜殿中將軍，稍遷平東將軍，封沃陽縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: He was appointed general of the palace guards, gradually transferred to general who pacifies the east, enfeoffed Baron of Woyang county with five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was made general of the palace guards, then rose to general who pacifies the east and was enfeoffed as baron of Woyang with five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 青州人崔社客舉兵反，永討平之。

translations.literal: Cui Sheke of Qing Province raised troops in rebellion; Yong suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Sheke of Qing Province rebelled, Yong crushed the rising.

sentences.zh: 進爵為侯，除左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Advanced in ennoblement to marquis, appointed left grand master for splendid happiness.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to marquis and appointed left grand master for splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 時有賊魁元伯生，率數百騎，西自崤、潼，東至鞏、洛，屠陷塢壁，所在為患。

translations.literal: At that time there was bandit chieftain Yuan Bosheng, who led several hundred horsemen, from the west from Xiao and Tong, east to Gong and Luo, slaughtered and overthrew walled compounds, and everywhere became a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the bandit leader Yuan Bosheng led several hundred horsemen from Xiao and Tong in the west to Gong and Luo in the east, sacking fortified settlements wherever he passed.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武遣京畿大都督匹婁昭討之，昭請以五千人行。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu of Wei sent capital-region area commander Pilou Zhao to suppress him; Zhao requested to go with five thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu dispatched capital-region area commander Pilou Zhao against him, and Zhao asked leave to take five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 永進曰：「此賊旣無城柵，唯以寇抄為資，安則蟻聚，窮則鳥散，取之在速，不在衆也。

translations.literal: Yong advanced and said: "These bandits have no walled fortifications; they rely only on raiding for sustenance; secure they swarm like ants, desperate they scatter like birds — taking them lies in speed, not in numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Yong stepped forward and said, "These bandits hold no walled camps and live by plunder alone. When safe they swarm like ants; when pressed they scatter like birds. Victory depends on speed, not numbers.

sentences.zh: 若星馳電發，出其不虞，精騎五百，自足平殄。

translations.literal: If we gallop like stars and strike like lightning, catch them unawares, five hundred picked horsemen suffice to wipe them out.
translations.idiomatic: Strike like lightning before they know we are coming, and five hundred elite horsemen will be enough to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 若徵兵而後往，彼必遠竄，雖有大衆，無所用之。

translations.literal: If we levy troops and then go, they will surely flee far; though we have a great host, it will be of no use."
translations.idiomatic: If we muster a large force first, they will vanish into the distance, and even a great army will be useless."

sentences.zh: 」帝然其計，於是命永代昭，以五百騎討之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his plan; thereupon he ordered Yong to replace Zhao and suppress them with five hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted the plan and sent Yong in Zhao's place with five hundred horsemen to destroy the band.

sentences.zh: 永覘知所在，倍道兼進，遂破平之。

translations.literal: Yong reconnoitered and learned where they were, pressed double marches, and then broke and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Yong located the band, forced a double march, and routed them completely.

sentences.zh: 帝西遷，永時不及從。

translations.literal: When the emperor moved west, Yong at the time could not follow in time.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor withdrew westward, Yong was unable to join him in time.

sentences.zh: 大統初，乃結宗人，潛謀歸款。

translations.literal: At the opening of Datong he then united clansmen and secretly plotted to submit loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Datong he gathered his clansmen and secretly planned to defect to the court.

sentences.zh: 密與都督趙業等襲斬西中郎將慕容顯和，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Secretly together with area commander Zhao Ye and others he made a surprise attack and beheaded western palace attendant Murong Xianhe, sending the head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In secret he joined area commander Zhao Ye and others in a surprise attack, beheaded western palace attendant Murong Xianhe, and sent the head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 以功別封昌平縣子，邑三百戶，除北徐州刺史。

translations.literal: For merit separately enfeoffed Viscount of Changping county with three hundred households, appointed inspector of Northern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: For this service he received a separate enfeoffment as viscount of Changping with three hundred households and was appointed inspector of Northern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 從擒竇泰，復弘農，破沙苑，竝有戰功。

translations.literal: Following the capture of Dou Tai, the recovery of Hongnong, and the victory at Shawan, he alike had battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: He won distinction in the capture of Dou Tai, the recovery of Hongnong, and the victory at Shawan.

sentences.zh: 進爵為公。

translations.literal: Advanced in ennoblement to duke.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to duke.

sentences.zh: 河橋之役，永力戰先登，授南汾州刺史。

translations.literal: In the battle of Heqiao Yong fought hard and was first to ascend; he was given inspector of Southern Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: At Heqiao he fought fiercely and was first over the wall; he was then made inspector of Southern Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 累遷大都督、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，賜姓爾綿氏。

translations.literal: Successively transferred to area commander, great general of chariots and cavalry, ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, general of fast cavalry, grand master with golden seal open office with ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and granted the surname Er'mian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through area commander, great general of chariots and cavalry, ceremony equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, general of fast cavalry, and open office equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and was granted the surname Er'mian.

sentences.zh: 魏廢帝元年，授恆州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, he was appointed Inspector of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, Yong was appointed inspector of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 于時朝貴多其部人，謁永之日，冠蓋盈路。

translations.literal: At that time many court grandees were natives of his department; on the day they came to pay respects to Yong, carriages and cap-covers filled the road.
translations.idiomatic: Many court grandees were natives of his department, and on the day they came to call on Yong, carriages and cap-covers filled the road.

sentences.zh: 當時榮之。

translations.literal: People at the time took pride in it.
translations.idiomatic: Men of the age counted it an honor.

sentences.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進爵廣城郡公，轉文州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was advanced to Duke of Guangcheng commandery and transferred to Inspector of Wen Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, Yong was raised to duke of Guangcheng commandery and transferred to inspector of Wen Province.

sentences.zh: 入為工部中大夫，遷軍司馬。

translations.literal: He entered service as middle grand master of the Ministry of Works and was transferred to army marshal.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as middle grand master of the Ministry of Works and was then made army marshal.

sentences.zh: 保定四年，拜大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoding he was appointed Great General.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoding year 4 he was made great general.

sentences.zh: 永歷任內外，所在頗有聲稱。

translations.literal: Yong held office both in the capital and in the provinces; wherever he served he enjoyed a considerable reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Yong served both in the capital and in the provinces, and wherever he held office he won a solid reputation.

sentences.zh: 輕財好士，朝野以此重焉。

translations.literal: He held wealth lightly and delighted in honoring men of talent; for this the court and the realm alike respected him.
translations.idiomatic: He was generous with his wealth and delighted in honoring men of talent, and for that the court and the realm alike respected him.

sentences.zh: 前後累增凡三千九百戶。

translations.literal: His fief was increased in all by three thousand nine hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In all, his fief grew by three thousand nine hundred households over the years.

sentences.zh: 天和四年，授小司寇。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianhe he was appointed Lesser Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year 4 he was appointed lesser minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 尋為右二軍總管，率兵北道講武。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was made area commander of the Right Second Army and led troops on the northern route for military review.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made area commander of the Right Second Army and led troops north for military review.

sentences.zh: 遇疾，卒于賀葛城，年六十八。

translations.literal: He fell ill and died at Hegcheng, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He took ill and died at Hegcheng at the age of sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 喪還，高祖親臨。

translations.literal: When his coffin returned, the Grand Progenitor personally came to attend.
translations.idiomatic: When his coffin returned, Emperor Wu personally came to attend.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、柱國大將軍、同華等五州刺史，諡曰基。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Bearer of the Staff, Pillar of State Great General, and Inspector of five provinces including Tong and Hua; posthumous name Ji.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given bearer of the staff, pillar of state great general, and inspector of five provinces including Tong and Hua; his posthumous name was Ji.

sentences.zh: 子岌嗣，官至儀同三司、兵部下大夫。

translations.literal: His son Ji succeeded; he reached the posts of Equal in Three Departments and lower grand master of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ji succeeded him and rose to equal in three departments and lower grand master of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 王士良字君明，其先太原晉陽人也。

translations.literal: Wang Shiliang, styled Junming, was descended from men of Jinyang in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shiliang, courtesy name Junming, came from a family of Jinyang in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 後因晉亂，避地涼州。

translations.literal: Later, because of the chaos of Jin, they fled to Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Jin fell into chaos, the family fled to Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 魏太武平沮渠氏，曾祖景仁歸魏，為燉煌鎮將。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taiwu of Wei pacified the Juqu clan, his great-grandfather Jingren submitted to Wei and became garrison general of Dunhuang.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taiwu of Wei conquered the Juqu, his great-grandfather Jingren came over to Wei and was made garrison general of Dunhuang.

sentences.zh: 祖公禮，平城鎮司馬，因家於代。

translations.literal: His grandfather Gongli was marshal of Pingcheng garrison and settled the family in Dai.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Gongli served as marshal of the Pingcheng garrison and established the family in Dai.

sentences.zh: 父延，蘭陵郡守。

translations.literal: His father Yan was Administrator of Lanling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yan was administrator of Lanling commandery.

sentences.zh: 士良少修謹，不妄交遊。

translations.literal: Shiliang from youth was careful and disciplined and did not associate lightly.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Shiliang was careful and disciplined and did not associate lightly.

sentences.zh: 魏建明初，爾朱仲遠啟為府參軍事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianming in Wei, Erzhu Zhongyuan recommended him as staff officer of the commandery office.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Jianming era Erzhu Zhongyuan recommended him as staff officer of the commandery office.

sentences.zh: 歷大行臺郎中、諫議大夫，封石門縣男，邑二百戶。

translations.literal: He served successively as bureau director of the mobile headquarters and remonstrance-and-advisement grand master, and was enfeoffed Baron of Shimen county with a fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as bureau director of the mobile headquarters and remonstrance-and-advisement grand master, and was enfeoffed baron of Shimen with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 後與紇豆陵步藩交戰，軍敗，為步藩所擒，遂居河右。

translations.literal: Later he fought Heduoling Buzhan; his army was defeated, he was captured by Buzhan, and remained on the west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Later he fought Heduoling Buzhan; his army was defeated, he was captured by Buzhan, and remained west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 偽行臺紇豆陵伊利欽其才，擢授右丞，妻以孫女。

translations.literal: The false mobile headquarters commissioner Heduoling Yili admired his talent, promoted him to right assistant director, and gave him his granddaughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel mobile headquarters commissioner Heduoling Yili admired his talent, promoted him to right assistant director, and gave him his granddaughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 士良旣為姻好，便得盡言，遂曉以禍福，伊利等並卽歸附。

translations.literal: Now linked by marriage, Shiliang could speak freely; he set forth fortune and disaster before them, and Yili and the others at once submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Once linked by marriage, Shiliang could speak freely; he set forth fortune and disaster before them, and Yili and the others at once submitted.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘉之。

translations.literal: The court commended him.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised him for it.

sentences.zh: 太昌初，進爵晉陽縣子，邑四百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taichang his title was advanced to Viscount of Jinyang county with a fief of four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Taichang he was raised to viscount of Jinyang with a fief of four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋進爵琅邪縣侯，授太中大夫、右將軍，出為殷州車騎府司馬。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was advanced to Marquis of Langya county, appointed Grand Master of Palace Leisure and Right General, and sent out as army marshal of the Chariots and Cavalry office of Yin Province.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was raised to marquis of Langya, appointed grand master of palace leisure and right general, and sent out as army marshal of the chariots and cavalry office of Yin Province.

sentences.zh: 東魏徙鄴之後，置京畿府，專典兵馬。

translations.literal: After Eastern Wei moved the capital to Ye, they established the Metropolitan Intendant office to hold sole charge of troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: After Eastern Wei moved the capital to Ye, it established the Metropolitan Intendant office to hold sole charge of troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 時齊文襄為大都督，以士良為司馬，領外兵參軍。

translations.literal: At the time Gao Cheng of Qi served as area commander; Shiliang was made army marshal and concurrently outer-troops staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Gao Cheng served as area commander; Shiliang was made army marshal and concurrently outer-troops staff officer.

sentences.zh: 尋遷長史，加安西將軍，徙封符壘縣侯，增邑七百戶。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to chief administrator, given the added title General Who Pacifies the West, had his title moved to Marquis of Fulei county, and his fief increased by seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to chief administrator, given the added title general who pacifies the west, moved to marquis of Fulei, and granted seven hundred additional fief households.

sentences.zh: 武定初，除行臺左中兵郎中，又轉大將軍府屬、從事中郎，仍攝外兵事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wuding he was appointed left central-troops bureau director of the mobile headquarters, then transferred to senior staff of the great general's office and attendant gentleman, and still held charge of outer military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Wuding he was appointed left central-troops bureau director of the mobile headquarters, then transferred to senior staff of the great general's office and attendant gentleman, while still holding charge of outer military affairs.

sentences.zh: 王思政鎮潁川，齊文襄率衆攻之。

translations.literal: Wang Sizheng held Yingchuan; Gao Cheng led troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sizheng held Yingchuan, and Gao Cheng led troops to attack him.

sentences.zh: 授士良大行臺右丞，加鎮西將軍，增邑一千戶，進爵為公，令輔其弟演於幷州居守。

translations.literal: Shiliang was appointed right assistant director of the great mobile headquarters, given the added title General Who Guards the West, his fief increased by one thousand households, and his title advanced to duke, and he was ordered to assist Cheng's younger brother Yan in holding and guarding Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang was appointed right assistant director of the great mobile headquarters, given the added title general who guards the west, a fief increase of one thousand households, and advancement to duke, and was ordered to assist Cheng's younger brother Yan in holding Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 齊文宣卽位，入為給事黃門侍郎，領中書舍人，仍總知幷州兵馬事，加征西將軍，別封新豐縣子，邑三百戶。

translations.literal: When Gao Yang of Qi ascended the throne, Shiliang entered service as attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently secretariat attendant, still holding overall charge of the troops and horses of Bing Province, given the added title General Who Campaigns West, and separately enfeoffed Viscount of Xinfeng county with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yang took the throne, Shiliang entered service as attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently secretariat attendant, still holding overall charge of Bing's troops and horses, given the added title general who campaigns west, and separately enfeoffed viscount of Xinfeng with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 俄除驃騎將軍、尚書吏部郎中。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General of Flying Cavalry and bureau director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed general of flying cavalry and bureau director of the Ministry of Personnel in the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 齊文宣自晉陽赴鄴宮，復士良為尚書左丞，統留後事。

translations.literal: When Gao Yang came from Jinyang to the palace at Ye, Shiliang was restored as left assistant director of the Masters of Writing and put in charge of affairs left behind.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yang came from Jinyang to the palace at Ye, Shiliang was restored as left assistant director of the masters of writing and put in charge of affairs left behind.

sentences.zh: 仍遷御史中丞，轉七兵尚書。

translations.literal: He was then transferred to imperial censor and moved to minister of the Seven Armies.
translations.idiomatic: He was next transferred to imperial censor, then to minister of the Seven Armies.

sentences.zh: 未幾，入為侍中，轉殿中尚書。

translations.literal: Before long he entered service as attendant-in-ordinary and was transferred to palace minister.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he entered court service as attendant-in-ordinary and was moved to palace minister.

sentences.zh: 頃之，復為侍中，除吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was again made attendant-in-ordinary and appointed minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was again made attendant-in-ordinary and given the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 士良頓首固讓，文宣不許。

translations.literal: Shiliang bowed his head and firmly declined; Gao Yang would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang kowtowed and steadfastly refused, but Gao Yang would not hear of it.

sentences.zh: 久之，還為侍中，又攝度支、五兵二曹尚書。

translations.literal: After some time he returned to attendant-in-ordinary and also held the ministries of Revenue and the Five Armies in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: After a time he returned to attendant-in-ordinary while also acting minister of Revenue and minister of the Five Armies.

sentences.zh: 士良少孤，事繼母梁氏以孝聞。

translations.literal: Shiliang lost his father young and served his stepmother, Lady Liang, with a filial reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang lost his father young and served his stepmother, Lady Liang, with a reputation for filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 及卒，居喪合禮。

translations.literal: When she died, he observed mourning in accordance with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When she died, he went into mourning as ritual required.

sentences.zh: 文宣尋起令視事，士良屢表陳誠，再三不許，方應命。

translations.literal: Gao Yang soon recalled him and ordered him to resume office; Shiliang repeatedly memorialized his sincerity, and only after several refusals was he allowed to obey.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang soon summoned him back and ordered him to resume office; Shiliang memorialized again and again in earnest protest, and only after repeated refusals was he permitted to obey.

sentences.zh: 文宣見其毀瘠，乃許之。

translations.literal: Gao Yang saw how emaciated he had become and then granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing how wasted he had become, Gao Yang at last granted leave.

sentences.zh: 因此臥疾歷年，文宣每自臨視。

translations.literal: For this reason he lay ill for years, and Gao Yang personally came to visit him each time.
translations.idiomatic: He remained bedridden for years on account of it, and Gao Yang came in person to visit each time.

sentences.zh: 疾愈，除滄州刺史。

translations.literal: When his illness passed, he was appointed Inspector of Cang Province.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness passed, he was appointed inspector of Cang Province.

sentences.zh: 幹明初，徵還鄴，授儀同三司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ganming he was recalled to Ye and appointed Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Ganming he was recalled to Ye and appointed equal in three departments.

sentences.zh: 孝昭卽位，遣三道使搜揚人物。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhao ascended the throne, he dispatched envoys on three routes to search out and promote worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozhao took the throne, he dispatched envoys on three routes to search out and promote worthy men.

sentences.zh: 士良與尚書令趙郡王高叡、太常卿崔昂分行郡國，但有一介之善者，無不以聞。

translations.literal: Shiliang, together with Minister of State Prince Gao Rui of Zhao commandery and Minister of Ceremonies Cui Ang, divided the commanderies and principalities among themselves; anyone with even the smallest merit was reported without exception.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang, together with Minister of State Prince Gao Rui of Zhao and Minister of Ceremonies Cui Ang, fanned out through the commanderies and principalities; not a man of even the smallest merit escaped report.

sentences.zh: 齊武成初，除太子少傅、少師，復除侍中，轉太常卿，尋加開府儀同三司，出為豫州道行臺，豫州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng in Qi he was appointed Junior Tutor and Junior Preceptor to the Crown Prince, again made attendant-in-ordinary, transferred to Minister of Ceremonies, soon given the added rank of Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments, and sent out as mobile headquarters commissioner of Yu Province route and Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Wucheng in Qi he was appointed junior tutor and junior preceptor to the crown prince, again made attendant-in-ordinary, transferred to minister of ceremonies, soon given the added rank of opening-office equal in three departments, and sent out as mobile headquarters commissioner of Yu Province route and inspector of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 崔彥穆字彥穆，清河東武城人也，魏司空、安陽侯林之九世孫。

translations.literal: Cui Yanmu, styled Yanmu, was a man of Dongwucheng in Qinghe and the ninth-generation descendant of Lin, Wei Minister of Works and Marquis of Anyang.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yanmu, courtesy name Yanmu, came from Dongwucheng in Qinghe and was the ninth in descent from Lin, who had served Wei as minister of works and marquis of Anyang.

sentences.zh: 曾祖顗，魏平東府諮議。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Yi was adviser to the Eastern Pacification office in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Yi had served Wei as adviser to the Eastern Pacification office.

sentences.zh: 祖蔚，遭從兄司徒浩之難，南奔江左。

translations.literal: His grandfather Wei, caught up in the disaster of his cousin-by-marriage, Minister of State Hao, fled south to the lands east of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Wei, swept up in the ruin of his cousin-by-marriage, Minister of State Hao, fled south across the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 仕宋為給事黃門侍郎，汝南、義陽二郡守。

translations.literal: He served Song as Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate and Administrator of Runan and Yiyang commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: He served Song as attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate and administrator of Runan and Yiyang commanderies.

sentences.zh: 延興初，復歸於魏，拜潁川郡守，因家焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yanxing he returned to Wei, was appointed Administrator of Yingchuan commandery, and settled his family there.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Yanxing he returned to Wei, was appointed administrator of Yingchuan commandery, and settled his family there.

sentences.zh: 後終於郢州刺史。

translations.literal: He later died in office as Inspector of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He later died in office as inspector of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父稚，篤志經史，不以世事嬰心。

translations.literal: His father Zhi was devoted to the classics and histories and did not let worldly affairs burden his mind.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhi immersed himself in the classics and histories, never troubling his mind with worldly affairs.

sentences.zh: 起家秘書郎，稍遷永昌郡守。

translations.literal: Upon entering office he was made Secretariat Gentleman and was gradually transferred to Administrator of Yongchang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering office he was made secretariat gentleman and was gradually transferred to administrator of Yongchang commandery.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇初，以獻後外曾祖，追贈上開府儀同三司、新州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang in Sui, because he was the maternal great-grandfather of Empress Xian, he was posthumously enfeoffed Upper Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments and Inspector of Xin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Kaihuang in Sui, because he was the maternal great-grandfather of Empress Xian, he was posthumously given upper opening-office equal in three departments and inspector of Xin Province.

sentences.zh: 彥穆幼明悟，神彩卓然。

translations.literal: Yanmu from childhood was bright and perceptive, with outstanding spirit and bearing.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood Yanmu was bright and perceptive, with outstanding spirit and bearing.

sentences.zh: 年十五，與河間邢子才、京兆韋孝寬俱入中書學，偏相友愛。

translations.literal: At age fifteen he entered the Central Secretariat Academy together with Xing Zicai of Hejian and Wei Xiaokuan of Jingzhao, and they became especially close friends.
translations.idiomatic: At fifteen he entered the Central Secretariat Academy together with Xing Zicai of Hejian and Wei Xiaokuan of Jingzhao, and they became especially close friends.

sentences.zh: 伏膺儒業，為時輩所稱。

translations.literal: He devoted himself to Confucian learning and was praised by men of his generation.
translations.idiomatic: He steeped himself in Confucian learning and won praise from his contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 魏吏部尚書隴西李神儁有知人之鑒，見而歎曰：「王佐才也。

translations.literal: Li Shenjun of Longxi, Wei Minister of Personnel, had a discerning eye for men; when he saw Yanmu he sighed and said, "This is ministerial talent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shenjun of Longxi, Wei minister of personnel, had a discerning eye for men; when he saw Yanmu he sighed and said, "This is ministerial talent.

sentences.zh: 」永安末，除司徒府參軍事，轉記室，遷大司馬從事中郎。

translations.literal: " At the end of Yongan he was appointed staff officer of the Minister over the Masses' office, transferred to recording secretary, and moved to attendant gentleman to the Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: " At the end of Yongan he was appointed staff officer of the minister over the masses' office, transferred to recording secretary, and moved to attendant gentleman to the grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武西遷，彥穆時不得從。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, Yanmu at the time could not follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu moved west, Yanmu at the time could not follow.

sentences.zh: 大統三年，乃與兄彥珍於成皋舉義，因攻拔滎陽，擒東魏郡守蘇淑。

translations.literal: In the third year of Datong he and his elder brother Yanzhen raised righteous troops at Chenggao, then captured Xingyang and seized Eastern Wei's commandery administrator Su Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong year 3 he and his elder brother Yanzhen raised righteous troops at Chenggao, then captured Xingyang and seized Eastern Wei's commandery administrator Su Shu.

sentences.zh: 仍與鄉郡王元洪威攻潁川，斬其刺史李景

translations.literal: He then with native-land prince Yuan Hongwei attacked Yingchuan and beheaded its inspector Li Jing
translations.idiomatic: Then, together with Prince Yuan Hongwei of Xiang commandery, he attacked Yingchuan and beheaded its inspector, Li Jing

translations.literal: (Dao) [emended variant]
translations.idiomatic: [emended: Yi]

translations.literal: [emended: Yi].
translations.idiomatic: The emendation reads Yi].

sentences.zh: 孝武嘉之，拜鎮東將軍、金紫光祿大夫、滎陽郡守。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu commended him and appointed him General Who Pacifies the East, Grand Master with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, and Administrator of Xingyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu commended him and appointed him general who pacifies the east, grand master with the golden seal and purple ribbon, and administrator of Xingyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼行右民郎中、潁川邑中正，賜爵千乘縣侯。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he additionally served as acting bureau director of the Right People in the Ministry of Domains and grand rectifier of Yingchuan, and was enfeoffed Marquis of Qiansheng county.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he additionally served as acting bureau director of the Right People in the Ministry of Domains and grand rectifier of Yingchuan, and was enfeoffed marquis of Qiansheng.

sentences.zh: 十四年，加使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍、司農卿。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was given the added titles Bearer of the Staff, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Three Departments, Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, and Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he was given the added titles bearer of the staff, grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in three departments, regular attendant of scattered cavalry, and minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 時軍國草創，衆務殷繁，太祖乃詔彥穆入幕府，兼掌文翰。

translations.literal: At the time the army and state were newly founded and affairs were numerous and pressing; the Grand Progenitor thereupon ordered Yanmu into his staff headquarters and additionally put him in charge of written documents.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the army and state were newly founded and affairs were numerous and pressing; Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai thereupon ordered Yanmu into his staff headquarters and additionally put him in charge of written documents.

sentences.zh: 及于謹

translations.literal: When Yu Jin
translations.idiomatic: Then, when Yu Jin

translations.literal: (Ping) [emended variant]
translations.idiomatic: [emended: campaign against]

sentences.zh: 〔伐〕江陵，彥穆以本官從平之。

translations.literal: [emended: campaign against] Jiangling, Yanmu followed in his existing rank and helped pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Jin campaigned against Jiangling, Yanmu followed in his existing rank and helped pacify it.

sentences.zh: 世宗初，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，俄拜安州總管、十一州諸軍事、安州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Shizong's reign he was promoted to General of Flying Cavalry and Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments; soon he was appointed Area Commander of An Province, commander of military affairs for eleven provinces, and Inspector of An Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Emperor Shizong's reign he was promoted to general of flying cavalry and opening-office equal in three departments; soon he was appointed area commander of An Province, commander of military affairs for eleven provinces, and inspector of An Province.

sentences.zh: 入為御正中大夫。

translations.literal: He entered service as middle grand master of the Imperial Rectification office.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as middle grand master of the Imperial Rectification office.

sentences.zh: 陳氏請敦鄰好，詔彥穆使焉。

translations.literal: Chen requested sincere neighborly relations, and the court ordered Yanmu as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Chen sought honest neighborly relations, and the court dispatched Yanmu as envoy.

sentences.zh: 彥穆風韻閑曠，器度方雅，善玄言，解談謔，甚為江陵所稱。

translations.literal: Yanmu's bearing was easy and open, his capacity and measure square and elegant; he was skilled in abstruse discourse and understood witty banter, and was greatly praised in Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Yanmu carried himself with easy openness and square, elegant breadth of spirit; he was adept at abstruse discourse and quick with witty banter, and Jiangling spoke highly of him.

sentences.zh: 轉民部中大夫，進爵為公。

translations.literal: He was transferred to middle grand master of the Ministry of Population and advanced in rank to duke.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to middle grand master of the Ministry of Population and raised to duke.

sentences.zh: 天和三年，復為使主，聘於齊。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianhe he again served as chief envoy on a mission to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year 3 he again served as chief envoy on a mission to Qi.

sentences.zh: 使還，除金州總管、七州諸軍事、金州刺史，進位大將軍。

translations.literal: When the mission returned, he was appointed Area Commander of Jin Province, commander of military affairs for seven provinces, and Inspector of Jin Province, and his rank was advanced to Great General.
translations.idiomatic: When the mission returned, he was appointed area commander of Jin Province, commander of military affairs for seven provinces, and inspector of Jin Province, and his rank was advanced to great general.

sentences.zh: 尋徵拜小司徒。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned and appointed Lesser Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was summoned and appointed lesser minister of education.

sentences.zh: 大象二年，宣帝崩，隋文帝輔政，三方兵起。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daxiang, Emperor Xuan died; Emperor Wen of Sui assisted the government, and armies rose on three sides.
translations.idiomatic: In Daxiang year 2, Emperor Xuan died; Emperor Wen of Sui assisted the government, and armies rose on three sides.

sentences.zh: 以彥穆為行軍總管，率兵與襄州總管王誼討司馬消難。

translations.literal: Yanmu was made campaign commander and led troops with Area Commander Wang Yi of Xiang Province to suppress Sima Xiaonan.
translations.idiomatic: Yanmu was made campaign commander and led troops with area commander Wang Yi of Xiang Province to suppress Sima Xiaonan.

sentences.zh: 軍次荊州，彥穆疑荊州總管獨孤永業有異志，遂收而戮之。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Jing Province, Yanmu suspected Area Commander Dugu Yongye of Jing Province of disloyal intent and thereupon seized and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When the army halted at Jing Province, Yanmu suspected area commander Dugu Yongye of Jing Province of disloyal intent and thereupon seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 及事平，隋文帝征王誼入朝，卽以彥穆為襄州總管、六州諸軍事、襄州刺史，加授上大將軍，進爵東郡公，邑二千戶。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Emperor Wen of Sui summoned Wang Yi to court and at once appointed Yanmu Area Commander of Xiang Province, commander of military affairs for six provinces, and Inspector of Xiang Province, additionally granting him Upper Great General, advancing him to Duke of Dong commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Emperor Wen of Sui summoned Wang Yi to court and at once appointed Yanmu area commander of Xiang Province, commander of military affairs for six provinces, and inspector of Xiang Province, additionally granting him upper great general, raising him to duke of Dong commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 頃之，永業家自理得雪，彥穆坐除名。

translations.literal: Before long Yongye's family cleared itself of blame on its own; Yanmu was stripped of name and office for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yongye's family cleared their own name; Yanmu was dismissed and stripped of rank for the offense.

sentences.zh: 尋復官爵。

translations.literal: Soon his office and title were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his rank and office were restored.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaihuang in Sui he died.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 1 in Sui he died.

sentences.zh: 子君綽嗣。

translations.literal: His son Junchuo succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Junchuo inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 君綽性夷簡，博覽經史，有父風。

translations.literal: Junchuo by nature was easy and simple, read widely in the classics and histories, and had his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: Junchuo was by nature easy and unpretentious, read widely in the classics and histories, and bore his father's character.

sentences.zh: 大象末，丞相府賓曹參軍。

translations.literal: At the end of Daxiang he was guest-cadre staff officer in the Chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Daxiang he was guest-cadre staff officer in the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 君綽弟君肅，解巾為道王侍讀。

translations.literal: Junchuo's younger brother Junsu, upon first taking office, became tutor to Prince Dao.
translations.idiomatic: Junchuo's younger brother Junsu, on first entering office, became tutor to Prince Dao.

sentences.zh: 大象末，潁川郡守。

translations.literal: At the end of Daxiang he was Administrator of Yingchuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Daxiang he was administrator of Yingchuan commandery.

sentences.zh: 令狐整字延保，燉煌人也，本名延，世為西土冠冕。

translations.literal: Linghu Zheng, styled Yanbao, was a man of Dunhuang; his original given name was Yan, and for generations his family had been the foremost house of the western lands.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Zheng, courtesy name Yanbao, came from Dunhuang; his original given name was Yan, and for generations his family had been the foremost house of the western lands.

sentences.zh: 曾祖嗣、祖詔安，竝官至郡守，咸為良二千石。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Si and grandfather Zhao'an both reached the rank of commandery administrator; both were good two-thousand-bushel officials.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Si and grandfather Zhao'an both rose to commandery administrator; both were capable two-thousand-bushel officials.

sentences.zh: 父虯，早以名德著聞，仕歷瓜州司馬、燉煌郡守、郢州刺史，封長城縣子。

translations.literal: His father Qiu was early famed for name and virtue; he served as marshal of Guazhou, administrator of Dunhuang commandery, and inspector of Ying Province, and was enfeoffed Viscount of Changcheng county.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qiu won early renown for character and ability; he served as marshal of Guazhou, administrator of Dunhuang, and inspector of Ying, and was enfeoffed Viscount of Changcheng.

sentences.zh: 大統末，卒於家。

translations.literal: At the end of the Datong era, he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Datong era he died at home.

sentences.zh: 太祖傷悼之，遣使者監護喪事，又敕鄉人為營墳壟。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor grieved for him, sent an envoy to oversee the funeral rites, and ordered the villagers to build his tomb mound.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai grieved for him, sent an envoy to supervise the funeral, and ordered the local people to build his tomb.

sentences.zh: 贈龍驤將軍、瓜州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Dragon-Soar General and Inspector of Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Dragon-Soar General and inspector of Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 整幼聰敏，沉深有識量。

translations.literal: Zheng from youth was intelligent and keen, deep and reserved, with judgment and capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was bright from childhood, thoughtful and farseeing.

sentences.zh: 學藝騎射，竝為河右所推。

translations.literal: In learning the arts and mounted archery, both were praised west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In scholarship and mounted archery alike he was admired throughout the Hexi region.

sentences.zh: 刺史魏東陽王元榮辟整為主簿，加蕩寇將軍。

translations.literal: Inspector Wei Prince Dongyang Yuan Rong recruited Zheng as chief clerk and granted him the title General Who Pacifies Bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Wei Prince Dongyang Yuan Rong recruited Zheng as chief clerk and made him General Who Pacifies Bandits.

sentences.zh: 整進趨詳雅，對揚辯暢，謁見之際，州府傾目。

translations.literal: Zheng's advance and conduct were detailed and refined; in audience and response he was fluent in debate; at audiences the prefecture and headquarters all turned their eyes to him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's bearing was polished and his replies eloquent; whenever he appeared before the prefecture and headquarters, all eyes were on him.

sentences.zh: 榮器整德望，嘗謂僚屬曰：「令狐延保西州令望，方城重器，豈州郡之職所可縶維。

translations.literal: Rong valued Zheng's virtue and reputation; he once told his staff: "Linghu Yanbao is the famed figure of the Western Province, a pillar of the realm — how can the duties of a commandery or prefecture hold him bound?
translations.idiomatic: Rong respected Zheng's character and standing; he once told his staff, "Linghu Yanbao is the leading man of the Western Province, a pillar of the state — how could a commandery or prefecture post hold him?

sentences.zh: 但一日千里，必基武步，寡人當委以庶務，書諾而已。」

translations.literal: Yet one who runs a thousand li in a day must first learn to walk on the drill ground; I shall entrust him with general affairs and merely sign my approval."
translations.idiomatic: A man who will run a thousand li in a day must first learn to march; I shall put the daily business in his hands and simply countersign."

sentences.zh: 頃之，魏孝武西遷，河右擾亂，榮仗整防扞，州境獲寧。

translations.literal: Before long, Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west; the land west of the Yellow River was in turmoil; Rong relied on Zheng for defense, and the prefecture's borders were kept at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, the Hexi region fell into disorder, and Rong relied on Zheng for defense until the prefecture was secure again.

sentences.zh: 及鄧彥竊瓜州，拒不受代，整與開府張穆等密應使者申徽，執彥送京師。

translations.literal: When Deng Yan seized Guazhou and refused replacement, Zheng with Opening-office Zhang Mu and others secretly responded to the envoy Shen Hui, seized Yan and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Deng Yan seized Guazhou and refused to yield office, Zheng and Opening-office Zhang Mu secretly backed the envoy Shen Hui, seized Yan, and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘉其忠節，表為都督。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor commended his loyalty and rectitude and memorialized him as area commander.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai praised his loyalty and recommended him as area commander.

sentences.zh: 尋而城民張保又殺刺史成慶，與涼州刺史宇文仲和構逆，規據河西。

translations.literal: Before long the city people Zhang Bao again killed Inspector Cheng Qing and joined with Liang Province Inspector Yuwen Zhonghe in rebellion, plotting to hold the lands west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the townsman Zhang Bao killed Inspector Cheng Qing and joined Liang Province inspector Yuwen Zhonghe in rebellion, intending to hold the Hexi region.

sentences.zh: 晉昌人呂興等復害郡守郭肆，以郡應保。

translations.literal: The people of Jinchang, Lü Xing and others, again killed Administrator Guo Si and yielded the commandery to Bao.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinchang, Lü Xing and others killed Administrator Guo Si and surrendered the commandery to Bao.

sentences.zh: 初，保等將圖為亂，慮整守義不從，旣殺成慶，因欲及整。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Bao and the others planned rebellion, they feared Zheng's steadfast loyalty and that he would not follow; having killed Cheng Qing, they then intended to get Zheng as well.
translations.idiomatic: When Bao and his party first plotted rebellion, they knew Zheng would not join; after killing Cheng Qing they planned to kill Zheng too.

sentences.zh: 以整人之望也，復恐其下叛之，遂不敢害。

translations.literal: Because of Zheng's standing among the people, they again feared his subordinates would turn against them, and so did not dare harm him.
translations.idiomatic: But Zheng was so widely respected that they feared his followers would revolt if he were harmed, and so they did not dare touch him.

sentences.zh: 雖外加禮敬，內甚忌整。

translations.literal: Outwardly they treated him with ceremony and respect; inwardly they greatly resented Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly they honored him; inwardly they deeply distrusted him.

sentences.zh: 整亦偽若親附，而密欲圖之。

translations.literal: Zheng also pretended to be close and attached, while secretly planning against them.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng in turn feigned loyalty while secretly plotting against them.

sentences.zh: 陰令所親說保曰：「君與仲和結為唇齒，今東軍漸逼涼州，彼勢孤危，恐不能敵。

translations.literal: In secret he had his confidants persuade Bao: "You and Zhonghe are united like lips and teeth; now the Eastern army is pressing Liang Province step by step — his position is isolated and perilous, and he may not be able to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Secretly he had his confidants tell Bao, "You and Zhonghe stand together like lips and teeth; now the Eastern army is closing on Liang Province, and his position is isolated and desperate — he may not hold out.

sentences.zh: 若或摧衄，則禍及此土。

translations.literal: If he suffers defeat, disaster will spread to this land.
translations.idiomatic: If he is broken, the disaster will reach this province too.

sentences.zh: 宜分遣銳師，星言救援。

translations.literal: You should detach elite troops and march at once to his relief.
translations.idiomatic: Send elite troops at once to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 二州合勢，則東軍可圖。

translations.literal: With the two provinces combined in strength, the Eastern army can be dealt with.
translations.idiomatic: With the two provinces united, the Eastern army can be defeated.

sentences.zh: 然後保境息人，計之上者。

translations.literal: Then you may secure the borders and give the people peace — that is the highest plan."
translations.idiomatic: Then you can secure the borders and give the people rest — that is the best plan."
[closing quote]

sentences.zh: 保然之，而未知所任。

translations.literal: Bao agreed, but did not yet know whom to appoint.
translations.idiomatic: Bao agreed, but had not yet chosen a commander.

sentences.zh: 整又令說保曰：「歷觀成敗，在於任使。

translations.literal: Zheng again had them persuade Bao: "Experience shows that success or failure lies in the choice of subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng again had his men tell Bao, "History shows that success or failure depends on whom you appoint.

sentences.zh: 所擇不善，旋致傾危。

translations.literal: Choose badly and ruin follows swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Choose the wrong man and disaster comes at once.

sentences.zh: 令狐延保兼資文武，才堪統御，若使為將，蔑不濟矣。

translations.literal: Linghu Yanbao combines civil and military gifts and has talent to command; if you make him general, nothing will fail."
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Yanbao has both civil and military talent and can lead an army; put him in command and nothing will go wrong."

sentences.zh: 」保納其計，具以整父兄等並在城中，弗之疑也，遂令整行。

translations.literal: Bao accepted the plan; because Zheng's father, elder brother, and the rest were all in the city, he did not suspect him, and so ordered Zheng to go.
translations.idiomatic: Bao took the advice; with Zheng's father, elder brother, and other kin all still in the city, he had no suspicions and sent Zheng out.

sentences.zh: 整至玉門郡，召集豪傑，說保罪逆，馳還襲之。

translations.literal: When Zheng reached Yumen commandery, he gathered the local leaders, denounced Bao's crimes and rebellion, and galloped back to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Yumen commandery, Zheng rallied the local leaders, denounced Bao's treason, and rode back to strike him.

sentences.zh: 先定晉昌，斬呂興。

translations.literal: He first secured Jinchang and beheaded Lü Xing.
translations.idiomatic: He first took Jinchang and executed Lü Xing.

sentences.zh: 進軍擊保。

translations.literal: He advanced and attacked Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Then he marched against Bao.

sentences.zh: 州人素服整威名，竝棄保來附。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture had long respected Zheng's renown; all abandoned Bao and came over to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture had long respected Zheng; they all deserted Bao and joined him.

sentences.zh: 保遂奔吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Bao thereupon fled to Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Bao fled to Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 衆議推整為刺史。

translations.literal: The assembly wished to make Zheng inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The leaders wanted to make Zheng inspector.

sentences.zh: 整曰：「本以張保肆逆，毒害無辜，闔州之人，俱陷不義。

translations.literal: Zheng said: "This began because Zhang Bao rose in rebellion and harmed the innocent; everyone in the prefecture was dragged into wrongdoing.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng said, "We rose up because Zhang Bao rebelled and harmed the innocent; the whole prefecture was implicated in his crime.

sentences.zh: 今者同心戮力，務在除兇，若其自相推薦，復恐效尤致禍。

translations.literal: Now we are united in heart and strength, and our task is to remove the villain; if we begin recommending one another, I fear we will invite imitation and bring disaster."
translations.idiomatic: Now we are united only to destroy the traitor; if we start promoting one another, I fear others will follow suit and bring fresh trouble."

sentences.zh: 」於是乃推波斯使主張道義行州事。

translations.literal: Thereupon they recommended the Persian envoy chief Zhang Daoyi to administer the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore put the Persian envoy chief Zhang Daoyi in charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 具以狀聞。

translations.literal: The full report was sent to the court.
translations.idiomatic: A full report was sent to court.

sentences.zh: 詔以申徽為刺史。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Shen Hui inspector.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shen Hui inspector.

sentences.zh: 徵整赴闕，授壽昌郡守，封

translations.literal: Zheng was summoned to court and appointed administrator of Shouchang commandery, and enfeoffed as
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was summoned to court, made administrator of Shouchang commandery, and enfeoffed as

translations.literal: (Xiang) [emended variant]
translations.idiomatic: [emended: Xiang]

sentences.zh: 〔襄〕武縣男，邑二百戶。

translations.literal: 〔Xiang〕 Baron of Xiangwu county, fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Baron of Xiangwu county with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 太祖謂整曰：「卿少懷英略，早建殊勳，今者官位，未足酬賞。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor said to Zheng: "You from youth have harbored heroic plans and early achieved outstanding merit; your present rank is not enough to repay your reward.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai told Zheng, "You have been bold in counsel since youth and won great merit early; your present office does not yet match your service.

sentences.zh: 方當與卿共平天下，同取富貴。

translations.literal: I shall yet share with you the pacification of the realm and take wealth and honor together."
translations.idiomatic: I mean to pacify the realm with you and share its rewards."

sentences.zh: 」遂立為瓜州義首。

translations.literal: He was thereupon made covenant chief of Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made covenant chief of Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 仍除持節、撫軍將軍、通直散騎常侍、大都督。

translations.literal: He was further appointed bearer of the staff, General Who Pacifies the Army, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and grand area commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was further made bearer of the staff, General Who Pacifies the Army, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and grand area commander.

sentences.zh: 整以國難未寧，常願舉宗效力。

translations.literal: Because the realm's troubles were not yet settled, Zheng constantly wished to bring his whole clan to serve.
translations.idiomatic: With the realm still unsettled, Zheng longed to bring his whole clan into service.

sentences.zh: 遂率鄉親二千餘人入朝，隨軍征討。

translations.literal: He thereupon led more than two thousand kinsmen and neighbors to court and followed the army on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He led more than two thousand kinsmen and neighbors to court and joined the campaigns.

sentences.zh: 整善於撫馭，躬同豐約，是以人衆竝忘羈旅，盡其力用。

translations.literal: Zheng was skilled at winning men; he shared hardship and ease with them, and so his followers all forgot they were far from home and gave their full strength.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng knew how to lead men; he shared their hardships and comforts, so his followers forgot they were far from home and gave everything they had.

sentences.zh: 遷使持節、車騎將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commissioner with full credentials, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Three Departments, and scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commissioner with full credentials, General of Chariots and Cavalry, equal in three departments, and scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 太祖常從容謂整曰：「卿遠祖立忠而去，卿今立忠而來，可謂積善餘慶，世濟其美者也。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor once said calmly to Zheng: "Your distant ancestor established loyalty by leaving; you now establish loyalty by coming — this may be called accumulated good bringing surplus blessing, with each generation adding to the family's honor."
